evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Domain jargon ('rollback') used natively, then crystallized into a plain-spoken aphoristic maxim — the document's register signature.
Native pipeline jargon naming the operational cadence; consistent with the document's technical baseline.
Flat, instrumental ownership attribution with no performative flourish — the document's matter-of-fact baseline.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses
mints.frame: Is the rule here entering as a matched antithesis — the same noun-phrase repeated in both clauses, the second negating the first — rather than as a simple imperative?
